name: travel-management
description: Travel Record & Invoice Management — web, Netlify, and Android

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build -w client && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
